title: Blue Dream House | KEY.co
description_expanded: The spacious living area, centered around a well-equipped entertainment setup, invites guests to unwind in style, while the full-scale kitchen provides everything needed for culinary exploration. Outside, the private back deck features seating and a grill for delightful al fresco dining. Sleeping arrangements include two opulent king primary suites with en suite bathrooms on the second floor, a cozy queen bedroom with an adjacent bath, and a whimsical third-floor space perfect for children, equipped with twin-over-twin bunk beds and a twin daybed with a trundle. Additional luxuries include two private balconies offering expansive views and a six-seat golf cart for easy exploration of the local area. This rental was everything we could’ve asked for. It was clean, the location was perfect, within walking distance to everything was needed. We loved the community pool. The golf cart was a huge plus for those times we wanted to venture down a little further. The booking process was a breeze. The fridge leaked and we sent the vacation company a text and they had someone there asap to fix it (although it didn’t mess with our stay in any way). We would definitely recommend this place & company to anyone!
